dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. I've decided to buy a new laptop for university.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. aɪv dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə ˈbaɪ ə ˈnuː ˈlæptɑːp fər ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great. This is the latest model. The keyboard is very comfortable.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ðɪs ɪz ðə ˈleɪtɪst ˈmɑːdəl. ðə ˈkiːbɔːrd ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkʌmftərbəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It looks nice. Are the speakers good?
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈlʊks ˈnaɪs. ər ðə ˈspiːkərz ˈɡʊd?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it works with wireless headphones, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ənd ɪt ˈwɜːrks wɪð ˈwaɪərləs ˈhɛdfoʊnz, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's too expensive for me. My dad agreed to pay half, but I need to save more.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtuː ɪkˈspɛnsɪv fər miː. maɪ ˈdæd əˈɡriːd tə ˈpeɪ ˈhæf, bʌt aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈseɪv ˈmɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. The store refuses to give discounts on new models.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri. ðə ˈstɔːr rɪˈfjuːzɪz tə ˈɡɪv ˈdɪskaʊnts ɑːn ˈnuː ˈmɑːdəlz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's OK. I'll come back next month. I'm learning to save money!
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈkʌm ˈbæk ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ. aɪm ˈlɜːrnɪŋ tə ˈseɪv ˈmʌni!
